Subject: PoC runbook, metering & entitlement questions

Hi Soojin / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we ramp the PoC we need a short ops/runbook doc that covers:
- how requests will route between CloudBridge and Redwood for the sell-with flow,
- metering signal expectations (per-call vs per-token mapping), and
- an initial fallback policy if dedicated capacity is saturated.

I've attached our integration spec (CB-integration-specs.pdf). Can Redwood provide a one-page runbook + a simple CSV that maps our SKU calls to Redwood meter names? Legal will need a heads-up on any non-standard SLA language.

High level asks:
1) Preliminary ops runbook by EOD Thursday (10/22)
2) Meter mapping CSV by next Tue (10/27)
3) Point of contact for commercial/PoC credits and any DocuSign routing

Ellie Ramos
VP, Partnerships — CloudBridge Solutions
ops@cloudbridge.io

Subject: Re: PoC runbook, metering & entitlement questions

Ellie —

Appreciate the spec. We can take the lead on a concise ops runbook and the meter mapping. I'll drop a v0.1 runbook here and loop in billing/commercial on the mapping and any credits.

Quick plan:
- Deliverable: redwood-cosell-runbook-v0.1.docx (attached) — includes routing diagram, TTLs, expected sequence lengths, and fallback ordering (hosted -> dedicated -> compatible-quantized).
- Metering: Vivek will own a first-pass CSV mapping to Redwood unit types; Ben will coordinate a short call with your billing ops if we need sample usage to validate rates.
- Legal/Docs: if you can share the DocuSign SOW link we’ll run through it with our contracts team; anything that touches SLA exceptions we escalate to Hannah for approvals.

Action items (owners):
- Soojin: finalize runbook v0.1 (done, attached) — please confirm if format okay.
- Vivek: meter mapping CSV by 10/27 — viv ek_kulkarni@redwood.com
- Ben: schedule a 30-min billing sync with CloudBridge ops (target next week) — ben_carter@redwood.com
- Hannah: review any SLA exceptions if they appear in the SOW — hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

I’ve also linked a private drive folder for collaboration: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_runbook

On a process note — we prefer the meter mapping as a simple two-column CSV (CloudBridge SKU, Redwood unit_name). That keeps HubSpot attribution straightforward.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

Redwood Inference

Thanks — adding details on metering mapping and a couple of gotchas we should call out:

1) CloudBridge calls with large context windows (> 2k tokens) will need a separate unit in our model catalog mapping to avoid mis-binning. If your SDK sends a context_length field we can do deterministic mapping; otherwise we suggest a runtime prefix that flags long-context usage.

2) Burst vs reserved capacity: for the PoC we'll assume Hosted API for first 90 days with a Dedicated fallback. Please confirm load profile (rps and p95 latencies) so we can size reserved pools.

3) Billing: we will provide meter-mapping-v1.csv with the CloudBridge SKU -> redwood_unit column; Ben will coordinate the sample usage export. Attached draft mapping.

On the DocuSign thread — share the link and we will table any SLA carve-outs. If the SOW requests a custom uptime SLA then Hannah will triage with sales.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Product Manager, Billing & Monetization
Redwood Inference

Attachment: metering-mapping-v1.csv (text/csv, 2KB)
